evidence.reason: The allegation that nothing reads Budget.maxOutputTokens/maxContextTokens is contradicted by the tip: the stopWhen array at src/driver/ai-sdk/index.ts lines 991-995 conditionally appends tokenBudgetCondition(budget.maxTokens) and, when either maxOutputTokens or maxContextTokens is defined, tokenMeterCondition(budget), alongside stepCountIs(effectiveStepCap). The surrounding comment documents this as the timer-free budget/tool-loop bound, using the same per-step usage fold. The supplied history shows the change that introduced the output-only fixer budget and the 200k context ceiling (token-meter stop condition), which is the later enforcement the finding asked for; the finding no longer describes the code at the reviewed state.
